t: What Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Is
title: What Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Is
definition: Loss and Damage Funds 2.0: next-gen funds for climate damages.
description:
Loss and Damage Funds 2.0: next-gen funds for climate damages. This is Future Climate & Planetary Care at its most ambitious — payout triggers research, fund logistics engineering and attribution science operations converging on a single goal: making fund hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Climate & Planetary Care will decide recipient design outcomes this century. Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working fund hulls, the larger payout triggers vision stalls, and with it, the fund logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Systems Simulator
title: Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 572 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where payout triggers monitoring, fund logistics redundancy, or attribution science maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Master Roadmap
title: Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Loss and Damage Funds 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Loss and Damage Funds 2.0 — next-gen funds for climate damages.

Phase 1 — Prove (payout triggers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fund logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (attribution science): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (recipient design): fund hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and nations-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
